about: Keep what you found (Build 164): three invented conversations heard to the end, then a keepsake asked for. Live charter.

conversations.name: leaving-mum
said: I've been offered a job far away and I'm scared to leave my mum on her own
she says she'll be fine but I don't believe her
I think I'm scared of being the one who left
ok. I think I need to actually talk with her properly

conversations.name: knowing-before
said: Sometimes I know the phone will ring just before it does
people think I'm weird when I say it
it's like a hum in the air first, then I just know
I want to trust it more

conversations.name: same-routine
said: what's the point of any of this
I don't mean anything dark. I'm just tired of the same routine every day
I used to draw, years ago
